title: Deep Learning-based Anonymization of Chest Radiographs: A Utility-preserving Measure for Patient Privacy
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a technical solution for patient privacy in medical imaging by anonymizing chest radiographs. While patient privacy is an ethical consideration, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethical frameworks themselves. It provides a technical method to address a privacy concern, rather than an ethics study.
